title: Many-Body Localization at Positive Density
exact_target: Formulate and prove stable localization for an infinite interacting quantum system at positive density.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001927 (OWR-11448-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Correlations and Interactions for Random Quantum Systems (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/50, pp. 2837--2890; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 2.

status_qualification: The report explicitly makes precise formulation part of the challenge. Results for a fixed finite number of particles do not cover this limit; neither a universal disorder threshold nor one preferred notion of many-body localization is specified by the extract.
